purpose: Teach: 森下/片岡/水谷/丹羽/高岡/今村/津田/岡村

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 森下部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's get started on preparing a welcome party for Director Mori.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. Quick breath. Setting the day's agenda with quiet authority. No hesitation—this is the plan.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。片岡課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll check over Manager Kataoka's handover notes.
lines.style: Responsive, steady. Confirming receipt without embellishment. Warm reliability—the kind of person you trust to actually follow through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 水谷技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share the project progress update from Mizutani, our technical lead.
lines.style: Instructive but collaborative. Measured pace. Leaning slightly into the responsibility of keeping things moving forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。丹羽広報の月次企画書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review Niwa's monthly plans from the PR department.
lines.style: Accepting the next task with the same steady competence. Brief, professional. No wasted energy—just moving to the next item.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 高岡顧問との面談を予定しましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule a meeting with Takaoka, our advisor.
lines.style: Clear directive. Slight emphasis on the name—making sure he knows exactly who and what. Keeping momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今村経理の決算予定を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll arrange the financial close schedule with Imamura from accounting.
lines.style: Smooth handoff. He's tracking each responsibility as it passes to him. Warm but efficient—almost a rhythm at this point.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 津田人事に新人研修プランを依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's ask Tsuda from HR to prepare the new hire training plan.
lines.style: Delegating with clarity. Measured tone. She's thinking ahead—this isn't urgent but it matters. No pressure in her voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。岡村法務に新契約レビューを依頼します
lines.en: Yes. I'll request a new contract review from Okamura in legal.
lines.style: Final item. Still composed but with a subtle sense of completion. Wrapping up the checklist with the same reliability as the first. Quiet satisfaction.
